segments.ja411:1.1: Kāḷāni kesāni pure ahesuṃ, jātāni sīsamhi yathāpadese;
segments.ja411:1.3: Tānajja setāni susīma [susima (ka.)] disvā, dhammaṃ cara brahmacariyassa kālo.
segments.ja411:2.1: Mameva deva palitaṃ na tuyhaṃ, mameva sīsaṃ mama uttamaṅgaṃ;
segments.ja411:2.3: “Atthaṃ karissan”ti musā abhāṇiṃ [abhāsiṃ (ka.)], ekāparādhaṃ khama rājaseṭṭha.
segments.ja411:3.1: Daharo tuvaṃ dassaniyosi rāja, paṭhamuggato hosi [hohi (sī.), hoti (ka.)] yathā kaḷīro;
segments.ja411:3.3: Rajjañca kārehi mamañca passa, mā kālikaṃ anudhāvī janinda.
segments.ja411:4.1: Passāmi vohaṃ dahariṃ kumāriṃ, sāmaṭṭhapassaṃ sutanuṃ sumajjhaṃ;
segments.ja411:4.3: Kāḷappavāḷāva pavellamānā, palobhayantīva [sā lobhayantīva (pī.)] naresu gacchati.
segments.ja411:5.1: Tamena passāmiparena nāriṃ, āsītikaṃ nāvutikaṃ va jaccā;
segments.ja411:6.1: Sohaṃ tamevānuvicintayanto, eko sayāmi [passāmi (ka.)] sayanassa majjhe;
segments.ja411:6.3: “Ahampi evaṃ” iti pekkhamāno, na gahe rame [na gehe rame (sī.), gehe na rame (syā. ka.)] brahmacariyassa kālo.
segments.ja411:7.1: Rajjuvālambanī cesā, yā gehe vasato rati;
segments.ja411:7.3: Evampi chetvāna vajanti dhīrā, anapekkhino kāmasukhaṃ pahāyāti.
